name: Camping 101: Tailoring
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Snang in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
narrative.offerRewardText: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
